messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: ordered bar graphs
parts:
Hi:

Here's a modified version using reorder() to order by frequency. The
legend is moved to the top to provide more space for the plot, but it
could easily be moved inside the graphics region with
legend.position() if the suggestion made doesn't work for you; e.g.,
legend.position = c(0.9, 0.15) with the legend.direction removed.

ggplot(new5, aes(x = reorder(ID, Count, mean), y = Count, fill = Group)) +
geom_bar(stat = 'identity') +
facet_wrap(~ Sample) +
labs(x = "", y = "") +
coord_flip() +
opts(legend.position = 'top',
legend.direction = 'horizontal',
axis.text.x = theme_text(size = 9),
axis.text.y = theme_text(size = 9, hjust = 1))

HTH,
Dennis
